## What changes, and why

Closes #

## How you checked it

- [ ] `npm run audit:gate && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build` passes
- [ ] New behaviour has a test next to the code
- [ ] Texts changed in the app are in all five dictionaries (or none changed)
- [ ] A database change comes as a new migration with row-level security and grants (or there is none)
- [ ] Screenshots for visible changes
